description: Proposed amalgamation of 96A and 96B (first and second floor units) into a single dwelling; excavation at basement level and creation of lightwell; construction of a rear two-storey extension with lantern rooflight; construction of rear dormer roof extension; terrace at the ground floor level; replacement windows, installation of rooflights and associated fenestration alterations.
decision_conditions:
Please could they provide the following:
Existing and Proposed Section Drawings (scale 1:50 or 1:100)
BNG statement using the template on the website; 
Demolition plans showing parts of the building to be fully or partially removed (supporting photographs encouraged, especially for historic buildings).
For Buildings of Townscape Merit, or Conservation Areas, detailed plans (scale not less than 1:20) must show new doors, windows, shop fronts, panelling, fireplaces, plaster mouldings, and other decorative features;
Inclusive design statement (can be included in the DAS)
Drainage Strategy incorporating Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS)

2. Does the applicant own the entire buiding and site including all flats? if not certificate B of application form needs to be completed.   

3. Please could you agree a new description of development?
'Proposed amalgamation of 96A and 96B (first and second floor units) into a single dwelling; excavation at basement level and creation of lightwell; construction of a rear two-storey extension with lantern rooflight; construction of rear dormer roof extension; terrace at the ground floor level; replacement windows, installation of rooflights and associated fenestration alterations'.
